sentences.text:
This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 28.03.2023 by Police Station -Morar, District Gwalior (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.212/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections , 366, 376 (2)(n),
506 Part - II of IPC.

I n brief, the prosecution case is that on 28.03.2023, prosecutrix aged about 31years lodged a computerized complaint with P.S. Morar, District Gwalior against present applicant/accused alleging that she is resident of Ghasmandi.
In May, 2015, she met with the present applicant/accused Balkrishn Agrawal in Balabai Ka Bazar, Near Dhurgamata temple in a dance class.
Thereafter, they developed friendship started talking with each other.
One day, he stopped her for having talk.
He committed sexual intercourse with her forcibly with the assurance that he will solemnize marriage.
For last 8 years in the pretext of solemnizing marriage, he abused her sexually.

On 24.03.2023, she telephoned and went to his house.
He ousted her from the house.
On her report, the aforesaid crime was registered.
She was sent for medical examination.
Nothing adverse has been found.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 28.03.2023.
Conclusion o f trial will take time.

On such premises,
learned counsel for the applicant prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposed the bail application and submits that applicant he harassed the deceased, therefore, bail should not be granted.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case but without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash security of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five thousand only) alongwith bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five thousand only) before the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving him any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE mani SUBASRI MANI 2023.04.21 18:33:45 -07'00'
